project.name: BusierBox
project.scope: BusierBox-maintained source code, scripts, tests, and documentation unless a file states a different license

compatibility.summary: The default integrated stack is GPLv2-compatible: BusierBox is GPL-2.0-or-later, BusyBox is GPL-2.0, Buildroot is GPL-2.0-or-later with package exceptions, doom-ascii is GPL-2.0-or-later, and miniz is permissive.

components.name: BusyBox
components.compatibility: GPLv2-compatible combined distribution; BusierBox dispatches to BusyBox and is not a BusyBox fork

components.name: Buildroot
components.compatibility: Compatible build system; payload packages keep their own licenses and notice/source obligations

components.name: doom-ascii
components.compatibility: GPLv2-compatible optional payload engine; game WAD data is user-provided and not bundled

components.name: miniz
components.compatibility: Permissive license compatible with GPL distribution when notices are preserved

distribution_guidance: Keep LICENSE and NOTICE with release bundles.
Keep manifests/sources.lock.json pinned for downloaded source archives.
Preserve third-party notices in third_party/ and LICENSES/.
Treat Buildroot-selected packages as separately licensed payload components.
Do not add a network-fetched component without pinned version, URL, SHA-256, filename, license, and homepage metadata.
